critiques.weakest_assumption: A safe computed eligibility view will protect consumers even though raw tables remain readable and neither absence reasons nor replacement guidance has a defined consumer contract.
critiques.likely_failure_mode: Query: `SELECT a.axis_code, CASE WHEN e.claim_id IS NULL THEN 'NOT_SCORABLE' ELSE 'SCORABLE' END disposition, i.lower_value, i.upper_value, u.symbol, NULL reason, NULL show_instead FROM axis a LEFT JOIN v_scoring_eligible_claim e ON e.axis_id=a.axis_id AND e.crop_id=:crop AND e.deployment_context_id=:context AND e.use_case='growth_score' LEFT JOIN claim_interval i ON i.claim_id=e.claim_id LEFT JOIN unit u ON u.unit_id=i.unit_id`; this can duplicate axes and cannot explain the roughly 94% of cells without eligible claims, while an easier raw-table join can mis-score them.
critiques.hidden_cost: The expensive part is not storing rows but designing, testing, and maintaining a context-aware delivery projection over 674 absence markers without relying on nonexistent SQLite permissions.
critiques.best_fix: Materialize and distribute a consumer-only table with one row per crop, deployment context, use case, and axis containing disposition, one selected band, reason code, and fallback guidance, while keeping raw claims out of the application database.

critiques.weakest_assumption: A stable typed envelope can hide enough JSON heterogeneity that a new dashboard author will not need undocumented payload-shape knowledge.
critiques.likely_failure_mode: Query: `WITH r AS (SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY axis_code ORDER BY scorable DESC, reviewed_at DESC) rn FROM fact_cache f WHERE crop_id=:crop AND context_key IN (:context,'*')) SELECT a.axis_code, COALESCE(r.scorable,0), json_extract(r.payload,'$.band.low'), json_extract(r.payload,'$.band.high'), json_extract(r.payload,'$.coverage.reason'), json_extract(r.payload,'$.replacement.text') FROM axis_catalog a LEFT JOIN r ON r.axis_code=a.axis_code AND r.rn=1`; a misspelled key becomes NULL and the arbitrary ranking can select the wrong purpose or scope.
critiques.hidden_cost: Versioned payload schemas, validators, migrations, and shape-specific query tests erase most of the claimed migration savings.
critiques.best_fix: Keep JSON only as an internal extraction format and compile a rigid, validated consumer projection with explicit disposition, band, reason, and fallback columns, eliminating LIKE-based scorability entirely.

critiques.weakest_assumption: Mandatory review produces semantically uniform records rather than merely approved records with reviewer-dependent roles, scopes, and identifiers.
critiques.likely_failure_mode: Query: `SELECT axis_code, disposition, band_low, band_high, unit, coverage_reason, fallback_text FROM crop_axis_projection WHERE crop_id=:crop AND deployment_context_id=:context ORDER BY axis_code`; C never requires the compiler to emit this relation, so consumers otherwise must reconstruct eligibility from reviewed JSONL and can reach different answers.
critiques.hidden_cost: Reviewing and maintaining stable identities for hundreds of justified absences, plus repairing source locators after document edits, is a larger burden than the handful of numeric bands suggests.
critiques.best_fix: Define the flat consumer projection as a mandatory compiler output, validate it against the 64-cell matrix, and use heading-plus-content hashes instead of line-number locators.

critiques.weakest_assumption: One crop-by-axis row can summarize all purposes and deployment scopes without hiding distinctions needed to choose the correct band or fallback.
critiques.likely_failure_mode: Query: `SELECT axis, CASE WHEN band_low IS NOT NULL THEN 'SCORABLE' ELSE 'NOT_SCORABLE' END disposition, band_low, band_high, unit, json_extract(metadata_json,'$.coverage_status') reason, json_extract(metadata_json,'$.guidance') show_instead FROM crop_axis WHERE crop_id=:crop AND json_extract(metadata_json,'$.deployment_context') IN (:context,'all')`; this can return no row for a valid context or expose one of several temperature claims without proving it is the growth target.
critiques.hidden_cost: The deferred migration arrives as soon as injury thresholds, daily-mean bands, cultivars, or deployment-specific guidance must be queried rather than merely audited.
critiques.best_fix: Retain the flat table only as a derived delivery projection, add explicit context, use-case, disposition, reason, fallback, and warning columns, and compile it from a validated multi-record evidence source.

critiques.weakest_assumption: The word SCORABLE remains safe when it covers fundamentally different outputs such as growth range checks, disease-risk thresholds, and calibrated proxies.
critiques.likely_failure_mode: Query: `SELECT axis_code, disposition, band_low, band_high, unit, non_scorable_reason, fallback_text FROM v_axis_disposition WHERE crop_id=:crop AND deployment_id=:deployment AND use_case='growth_score'`; a consumer that omits or missets the use-case predicate can present canopy RH or calibrated lux as a growth score despite the settled finding.
critiques.hidden_cost: Calibration governance, reference-instrument requirements, expiry, and deployment-scope identity become a second evidence system whose authority the current corpus cannot supply.
critiques.best_fix: Replace generic SCORABLE with distinct result kinds such as GROWTH_RANGE_CHECK, RISK_WARNING, and CALIBRATED_PROXY, and permit numeric product scoring only for the first.

critiques.weakest_assumption: Each absent crop-axis cell has one context-appropriate section 9 action that can safely replace a score without further scientific or editorial judgment.
critiques.likely_failure_mode: Query: `SELECT axis_code, presentation_kind, score_low, score_high, unit, coverage_status AS reason, replacement_action AS show_instead, provenance_ref FROM v_crop_axis_card WHERE crop_id=:crop AND deployment_id=:deployment ORDER BY display_order`; unless advisory numeric fields are forced NULL, disease-risk values can still render as score-like bands and mislead users.
critiques.hidden_cost: Adapting Korean prose, resolving 674 absence statements into consistent reason codes, and maintaining context-specific copy is substantive product work rather than a minor UI layer.
critiques.best_fix: Adopt the crossed validation threshold now: make this a guidance-first projection, require one row for every axis, and structurally prohibit score fields for advisory and monitor-only states.

critiques.weakest_assumption: Exact historical replay is valuable enough now to precede the much more immediate need for a safe consumer query contract.
critiques.likely_failure_mode: Query: `ATTACH DATABASE :knowledge_path AS kb; WITH r AS (SELECT revision_id FROM kb.revision WHERE effective_at<=:as_of ORDER BY effective_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT p.axis_code, p.disposition, p.band_low, p.band_high, p.reason, p.fallback_text FROM kb.crop_axis_projection p JOIN r USING(revision_id) JOIN main.deployment d ON d.context_hash=p.context_hash WHERE d.deployment_id=:deployment AND p.crop_id=:crop`; G defines neither the projection nor context matching, so ATTACH and revision selection add failure points without answering the consumer question.
critiques.hidden_cost: Two-file packaging, connection management, coordinated backups, migration replay, and revision-selection tests consume hackathon time with no improvement to the measured 3-5 usable cells.
critiques.best_fix: Keep one immutable knowledge release for now and stamp its revision or manifest hash on rendered results, postponing database separation until measured write contention or audit demand exists.

critiques.weakest_assumption: Stakeholders will accept a condition monitor with no composite score and will not reinterpret range checks as evidence of plant health.
critiques.likely_failure_mode: Query: `SELECT axis_code, current_value, display_kind, range_low, range_high, why_no_range, guidance_text FROM v_condition_monitor WHERE crop_id=:crop AND deployment_id=:deployment ORDER BY display_order`; H needs F or a corrected D to provide this view, and without duration evidence temperature alerts can flap while appearing biologically meaningful.
critiques.hidden_cost: The product promise, visual hierarchy, alert policy, and stakeholder expectations must all be redesigned around guidance rather than gamified scoring.
critiques.best_fix: Pair H with F's exhaustive card projection, label temperature strictly as an instantaneous or daily-mean range check as applicable, and use clearly disclosed UI hysteresis only to suppress visual noise.

decision_crux: Can the team commit to H's guidance-first, no-composite-score product contract? If yes, F plus a corrected D-style delivery projection minimizes consumer error; if no, the remaining designs require substantially stronger semantic barriers than SQLite views can provide.
